Welcome to a brand new and modern part of a semi-detached house. The home is bright, stylish, and fully equipped, and has never been occupied before. Here you will have a clean and comfortable stay in quiet surroundings, with everything you need. At this place you can stay close to the center of Jessheim, Nordby train station, and Gardermoen. 

Linen and towels are not included in the price. Rental of one set of bed linens and one towel costs 100 NOK per person per stay. Please let us know in advance if you'd like to rent.
